(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let ((n (rows g)))
           (build-grid (* 3 n)
                       (* 3 n)
                       (r c)
                       (let ((br (quotient r n))
                             (bc (quotient c n))
                             (lr (mod r n))
                             (lc (mod c n)))
                         (at g
                             (if (even? br) (- n 1 lr) lr)
                             (if (even? bc) (- n 1 lc) lc)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((n (rows g))
         (intermediate
          (build-grid (* 3 n) (* 3 n) (r c)
            (let ((br (quotient r n))
                  (bc (quotient c n))
                  (lr (mod r n))
                  (lc (mod c n)))
              (at g
                  (if (even? br) (- n 1 lr) lr)
                  (if (even? bc) (- n 1 lc) lc)))))
         (target
          (first
           (filter
            (lambda (obj) (member? (list n n) (obj-cells obj)))
            (objects intermediate 0)))))
    (paint-cells intermediate (obj-cells target) 0))))
